В отрывке Льюиса Кэрролла действие происходит на берегу реки. Подходит riverbank.

title: A Picture in a Book
question: Choose the closest meaning of “picture”.
context:
Find the word’s meaning in the text.

Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do: once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading, but it had no pictures or conversations in it, “and what is the use of a book,” thought Alice “without pictures or conversation?” So she was considering in her own mind (as well as she could, for the hot day made her feel very sleepy and stupid), whether the pleasure of making a daisy-chain would be worth the trouble of getting up and picking the daisies, when suddenly a White Rabbit with pink eyes ran close by her.
steps: Pictures здесь — изображения, которых не хватает в книге.
Illustration — рисунок, который сопровождает текст.

title: Making a Daisy Chain
question: Choose the closest meaning of “pleasure”.
context:
Find the word’s meaning in the text.

Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do: once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading, but it had no pictures or conversations in it, “and what is the use of a book,” thought Alice “without pictures or conversation?” So she was considering in her own mind (as well as she could, for the hot day made her feel very sleepy and stupid), whether the pleasure of making a daisy-chain would be worth the trouble of getting up and picking the daisies, when suddenly a White Rabbit with pink eyes ran close by her.
steps: Pleasure — удовольствие, которое Алиса может получить от плетения.
Delectation — книжное слово со значением «наслаждение».

title: Weighing the Effort
question: Choose the closest meaning of “worth”.
context:
Find the word’s meaning in the text.

Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do: once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading, but it had no pictures or conversations in it, “and what is the use of a book,” thought Alice “without pictures or conversation?” So she was considering in her own mind (as well as she could, for the hot day made her feel very sleepy and stupid), whether the pleasure of making a daisy-chain would be worth the trouble of getting up and picking the daisies, when suddenly a White Rabbit with pink eyes ran close by her.
steps: «Be worth the trouble» значит «стоить затраченных усилий».
Worthwhile также означает «стоящий усилий». Современное написание обычно слитное.

title: Picking Daisies
question: Choose the closest meaning of “pick”.
context:
Find the word’s meaning in the text.

Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do: once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading, but it had no pictures or conversations in it, “and what is the use of a book,” thought Alice “without pictures or conversation?” So she was considering in her own mind (as well as she could, for the hot day made her feel very sleepy and stupid), whether the pleasure of making a daisy-chain would be worth the trouble of getting up and picking the daisies, when suddenly a White Rabbit with pink eyes ran close by her.
adaptation: Вариант A исправлен. В исходнике peck.
steps: Алиса собирается встать и сорвать маргаритки для венка.
Pick здесь означает собирать цветы, gather.

title: Saturday Plans
question: I think I … on Saturday, but I’m not sure.
steps: But I’m not sure показывает, что план пока не определён.
May выражает возможность. «Get my hair cut» означает, что волосы подстрижёт кто-то другой.

title: Painting the House
question: He … when he can afford it.
choices: is going to have his house painted
steps: When he can afford it связывает намерение с будущей возможностью оплатить работу.
«Is going to have his house painted» означает «собирается заказать покраску дома».

title: A Precaution
question: You should take malaria tablets before going to India … you get bitten by a mosquito.
steps: Таблетки принимают заранее, на случай возможного укуса.
In case вводит обстоятельство, ради которого принимается мера предосторожности.

title: Meals for the Puppies
question: The dog only has one meal, but the puppies … three times a day.
steps: Щенков необходимо кормить, то есть действие направлено на них.
Need + форма на -ing передаёт пассивный смысл, «need feeding».

title: A Difficult Exam
question: The exam was too difficult … .
steps: Too difficult требует дополнения, кому и что слишком трудно делать.
Конструкция «for him to complete» означает «чтобы он его выполнил».

title: Sales and Marketing
question: I have a good job. I’m … sales and marketing.
steps: Говорящий отвечает за продажи и маркетинг.
Устойчивый оборот «in charge of» выражает эту обязанность.

title: An Old Friendship
question: I … a friend called Bob, but we’ve stopped writing to each other.
steps: Дружба относится к прошлому. Now they have stopped writing.
Used to have подходит для состояния, которое было раньше.

title: Returning a Favour
question: If someone does you a favor, you … a favor in return.
steps: In return означает «в ответ». Здесь речь о совете отвечать добром на помощь.
Should выражает совет. Do them a favor — «оказать им услугу».

title: Outside with Journalists
question: There are a lot of journalists outside. What’s …?
steps: Говорящий хочет узнать, что сейчас происходит.
«What’s going on?» — обычный вопрос «Что происходит?».

title: Commuting in Town
question: … people in my town go to work by car.
steps: People определены оборотом in my town. Речь о группе жителей конкретного города.
Most of the people означает «большинство этих людей». Most of people без the в такой конструкции не употребляется.
